extracted.name: Shaved Brussels Sprout Salad
extracted.description: An easy and delicious shaved Brussels sprout salad made with just 7 ingredients! The perfect salad to make ahead for holiday gatherings or pack for lunch.
ingredient_lines: ¼ cup extra-virgin olive oil (plus more for drizzling)
Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
instruction_lines: Thinly slice the Brussels sprouts using a mandoline if you have one. Place them into a medium bowl and toss with the olive oil, lemon juice, pine nuts, cranberries, pecorino cheese, chives, and pinches of salt and pepper.
Let the salad sit at room temperature for 15 minutes, then taste and adjust the seasonings. Finish with an additional drizzle of olive oil if you like.
